SHOT: Extreme macro, 4:5, of the two clusters facing each other across the gap on the wide flat band: the large pear with its medium and small rounds on one end, the two pears with their small round and the row of tiny gold beads on the other, resting on the top face of a cream plaster cube. Camera very close; the piece fills about two thirds of the frame; razor-sharp on the stones and the metal edges, the rest falling softly out of focus.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is our approved packshot of this exact piece and the ONLY authority on what it is: copy its construction, proportions, metal colour and stone colour EXACTLY; ignore its cube and its background. IMAGE 1 is a close view, so the piece's SIZE in this picture comes ONLY from the SCALE TEST below. IMAGE 2 is the authority for the plaster, the background and the light only.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: AN OPEN CLUSTER RING on a WIDE, FLAT polished gold band, exactly as IMAGE 1 and IMAGE 2 show: the band is about 10 to 12mm wide, wider than its largest stone is long, flat across its face with crisp squared edges and a mirror polish, like a wide cigar band, and it does NOT close: its two squared-off ends meet on top with a narrow gap. The stones sit LOW, close to the band's flat face beside the gap, each in small gold claws. One end carries THREE clear stones in a cluster: ONE large PEAR, ONE medium ROUND beside the pear's rounded end, and ONE small ROUND tucked between them. The other end carries THREE clear stones: TWO PEARS side by side, their rounded ends together and their points turned outward, and ONE small ROUND at their outer side, with a row of tiny gold beads running along the band's cut edge beside the pears. All stones clear. Exactly SIX stones: three pears and three rounds (one medium, two small); never coloured stones, never a full pave band, never a closed band; the band is wide and flat with squared edges, never slim, never rounded like a wire, never tapered; the stones are never raised high on posts or tall blocks.

SCALE TEST: The band is about 10 to 12mm wide; the large pear about 6 x 8mm, the medium round about 5mm, the small rounds about 3mm, the two pears on the other end about 5 x 7mm; each cluster about 10 to 12mm across.

LIGHT: Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow, plus ONE small hard specular kicker from the right, so the metal shows a bright moving highlight and a dark rolled edge on every curve, and every stone shows internal sparkle and a hard white point, never flat colour.

ABSENCE LIST: No hand, no ear, no model, no fabric, no props. No second piece of jewellery. Metal: warm 18k gold tone, never brassy, orange or greenish. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. The picture runs edge to edge as a crisp, clean, modern digital studio photograph, shot today on a high-resolution digital camera.

SHOT: A worn photograph: the model's hand raised and resting lightly on her collarbone, the WHOLE hand in frame, all its fingers and the wrist, the ring a small accent on one finger in true proportion to the hand. 4:5 vertical, full bleed.

CROP: The frame is cut straight across just ABOVE THE UPPER LIP. NO eyes, NO eyebrows, NO forehead anywhere in this picture. Inside the frame: hand, fingers, wrist, collarbone and shoulder.

IMAGE 1 is a close view, so the piece's SIZE in this picture comes ONLY from the SCALE TEST below. IMAGE 2 is the authority on the model, skin, garment, hair, ground and light: match it exactly, but she wears ONLY the piece from IMAGE 1, worn on the RING FINGER only (the fourth finger), the wide band covering much of the segment between the knuckle and the first joint, the two clusters side by side across the top of the finger: on one side the large pear with its two rounds, on the other the two pears with their small round and the row of tiny gold beads, exactly as IMAGE 1 shows; any other jewellery in IMAGE 2 is removed.

THE PLATE: A young Indian woman, late twenties, warm mid-brown skin with golden undertones. Long dark brown hair in loose natural waves. Bare shoulders, marigold-saffron silk camisole with narrow spaghetti straps. Nails short, bare, pale nude, no polish colour. Warm cream seamless with a gentle gradient falloff, never sand, tan, beige or golden. Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow.
